annotations.title: Venue lead-lag: who moves first (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance)

description: Call this when the user asks which exchange leads price discovery or whether spot or perp moves first. Returns per-pair daily cross-correlations of one-minute returns at lags -3..+3 and the lead asymmetry, with the share of days each venue led. Each pair's daily rows cover the last 7 days (its summary covers the whole window); pass days (up to 30) for more.

days.description: Optional. Daily rows per pair, newest kept (default 7, up to 30).

name: get_lead_lag
